title: Techstack own application v2

image.description: Public DNS registry over HTTPS port 443 only. Go admission rejects IP literals, localhost, single-label hosts, private/reserved/unknown public suffixes; transport rejects non-public DNS answers and HTTP redirects/token endpoints. Create/update dry review resolves tags before approval; offline render requires a digest-pinned desired image. Execution binds the reviewed resolvedImage, imports its verified blobs through the same HTTPS transport, and runs the node-derived immutable config image ID with pull_policy never.

hostname.description: Exactly own-<name>.<installation-domain>; checked contextually by StackKits.

secretRefs.description: Each key K must reference exactly secret://own-<name>/K; created via the own operation private secrets-file, never foreign custody.

mountPath.description: Clean absolute container path; system paths, host mounts and Docker socket are refused.

outboundInternet.description: Public IPv4 Internet only, admitted only with the managed host nftables firewall. IPv6 is disabled. No automatic restart; reviewed update restores after reboot.

description: Closed v2 own-application intent. Identical to v1 except optional outboundInternet (default false). Inbound routing/sign-in and approval are unchanged. Outbound requires verified kit-owned host rules; all special-use ranges, host and connected networks are denied.
